create.description: Controls whether resources should be created

create_role.description: Controls whether IAM roles should be created

create_pipe_role_only.description: Controls whether an IAM role should be created for the pipes only

append_rule_postfix.description: Controls whether to append '-rule' to the name of the rule

append_connection_postfix.description: Controls whether to append '-connection' to the name of the connection

append_destination_postfix.description: Controls whether to append '-destination' to the name of the destination

append_schedule_group_postfix.description: Controls whether to append '-group' to the name of the schedule group

append_schedule_postfix.description: Controls whether to append '-schedule' to the name of the schedule

append_pipe_postfix.description: Controls whether to append '-pipe' to the name of the pipe

create_bus.description: Controls whether EventBridge Bus resource should be created

create_rules.description: Controls whether EventBridge Rule resources should be created

create_targets.description: Controls whether EventBridge Target resources should be created

create_permissions.description: Controls whether EventBridge Permission resources should be created

create_archives.description: Controls whether EventBridge Archive resources should be created

create_connections.description: Controls whether EventBridge Connection resources should be created

create_api_destinations.description: Controls whether EventBridge Destination resources should be created

create_schemas_discoverer.description: Controls whether default schemas discoverer should be created

create_schedule_groups.description: Controls whether EventBridge Schedule Group resources should be created

create_schedules.description: Controls whether EventBridge Schedule resources should be created

create_pipes.description: Controls whether EventBridge Pipes resources should be created

create_log_delivery_source.description: Controls whether EventBridge log delivery source resource should be created

create_log_delivery.description: Controls whether EventBridge log delivery resources should be created

region.description: Region where the resource(s) will be managed. Defaults to the region set in the provider configuration

bus_name.description: A unique name for your EventBridge Bus

log_config.description: The configuration block for the EventBridge bus log config settings

log_delivery.description: Map of the configuration block for the EventBridge bus log delivery settings (key is the type of log delivery: cloudwatch_logs, s3, firehose)

event_source_name.description: The partner event source that the new event bus will be matched with. Must match name.

kms_key_identifier.description: The identifier of the AWS KMS customer managed key for EventBridge to use, if you choose to use a customer managed key to encrypt events on this event bus. The identifier can be the key Amazon Resource Name (ARN), KeyId, key alias, or key alias ARN.

dead_letter_config.description: Configuration details of the Amazon SQS queue for EventBridge to use as a dead-letter queue (DLQ)

rules.description: A map of objects with EventBridge Rule definitions.

targets.description: A map of objects with EventBridge Target definitions.

archives.description: A map of objects with the EventBridge Archive definitions.

permissions.description: A map of objects with EventBridge Permission definitions.

connections.description: A map of objects with EventBridge Connection definitions.

api_destinations.description: A map of objects with EventBridge Destination definitions.

schedule_groups.description: A map of objects with EventBridge Schedule Group definitions.

schedules.description: A map of objects with EventBridge Schedule definitions.

pipes.description: A map of objects with EventBridge Pipe definitions.

tags.description: A map of tags to assign to resources.

schedule_group_timeouts.description: A map of objects with EventBridge Schedule Group create and delete timeouts.

role_name.description: Name of IAM role to use for EventBridge

role_description.description: Description of IAM role to use for EventBridge

role_path.description: Path of IAM role to use for EventBridge

policy_path.description: Path of IAM policy to use for EventBridge

role_force_detach_policies.description: Specifies to force detaching any policies the IAM role has before destroying it.

role_permissions_boundary.description: The ARN of the policy that is used to set the permissions boundary for the IAM role used by EventBridge

role_tags.description: A map of tags to assign to IAM role

ecs_pass_role_resources.description: List of approved roles to be passed

attach_kinesis_policy.description: Controls whether the Kinesis policy should be added to IAM role for EventBridge Target

attach_kinesis_firehose_policy.description: Controls whether the Kinesis Firehose policy should be added to IAM role for EventBridge Target

attach_sqs_policy.description: Controls whether the SQS policy should be added to IAM role for EventBridge Target

attach_sns_policy.description: Controls whether the SNS policy should be added to IAM role for EventBridge Target

attach_ecs_policy.description: Controls whether the ECS policy should be added to IAM role for EventBridge Target

attach_lambda_policy.description: Controls whether the Lambda Function policy should be added to IAM role for EventBridge Target

attach_sfn_policy.description: Controls whether the StepFunction policy should be added to IAM role for EventBridge Target

attach_cloudwatch_policy.description: Controls whether the Cloudwatch policy should be added to IAM role for EventBridge Target

attach_api_destination_policy.description: Controls whether the API Destination policy should be added to IAM role for EventBridge Target

attach_tracing_policy.description: Controls whether X-Ray tracing policy should be added to IAM role for EventBridge

kinesis_target_arns.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Kinesis Streams you want to use as EventBridge targets

kinesis_firehose_target_arns.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Kinesis Firehose Delivery Streams you want to use as EventBridge targets

sqs_target_arns.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the AWS SQS Queues you want to use as EventBridge targets

sns_target_arns.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the AWS SNS's you want to use as EventBridge targets

sns_kms_arns.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the AWS KMS's configured for AWS SNS you want Decrypt/GenerateDataKey for

ecs_target_arns.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the AWS ECS Tasks you want to use as EventBridge targets

lambda_target_arns.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Lambda Functions you want to use as EventBridge targets

sfn_target_arns.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the StepFunctions you want to use as EventBridge targets

cloudwatch_target_arns.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Cloudwatch Log Streams you want to use as EventBridge targets

attach_policy_json.description: Controls whether policy_json should be added to IAM role

attach_policy_jsons.description: Controls whether policy_jsons should be added to IAM role

attach_policy.description: Controls whether policy should be added to IAM role

attach_policies.description: Controls whether list of policies should be added to IAM role

number_of_policy_jsons.description: Number of policies JSON to attach to IAM role

number_of_policies.description: Number of policies to attach to IAM role

attach_policy_statements.description: Controls whether policy_statements should be added to IAM role

trusted_entities.description: Additional trusted entities for assuming roles (trust relationship)

policy_json.description: An additional policy document as JSON to attach to IAM role

policy_jsons.description: List of additional policy documents as JSON to attach to IAM role

policy.description: An additional policy document ARN to attach to IAM role

policies.description: List of policy statements ARN to attach to IAM role

policy_statements.description: Map of dynamic policy statements to attach to IAM role
